item.title: AI 交付资产化
item.summary: 外部证据显示，AI交付资产不是模板文件数量，而是带版本、依赖、数据/语义绑定、测试、权限、部署、运行遥测、升级和退役责任的可复用生产单元。Microsoft/Oracle以应用内模板库控制场景与分发，AWS/Google以云市场和运行时控制部署，OpenAI/Anthropic以SDK与Skill控制开发原语，Databricks/Palantir以数据、Ontology和Solution Accelerator控制业务上下文，Cognizant类伙伴把行业蓝图与交付人力结合。资产化已进入pilot，但跨客户同cohort的复用率、定制工时、维护成本、质量保持、续约和毛利未披露，不能判scaling。

synthesis.outlook_12_36m: 未来资产将从静态模板分化为四层：可移植Skill/工具原语、带平台依赖的部署包、绑定行业对象与数据语义的业务蓝图、带评估与运行责任的托管资产。赢家不是资产最多，而是能证明跨客户复用、定制负担下降、质量保持、升级安全和可归因扩张收入。若同cohort经营数据持续缺失，阶段仍停留pilot。
synthesis.strategic_summary: 外部证据显示，AI交付资产不是模板文件数量，而是带版本、依赖、数据/语义绑定、测试、权限、部署、运行遥测、升级和退役责任的可复用生产单元。Microsoft/Oracle以应用内模板库控制场景与分发，AWS/Google以云市场和运行时控制部署，OpenAI/Anthropic以SDK与Skill控制开发原语，Databricks/Palantir以数据、Ontology和Solution Accelerator控制业务上下文，Cognizant类伙伴把行业蓝图与交付人力结合。资产化已进入pilot，但跨客户同cohort的复用率、定制工时、维护成本、质量保持、续约和毛利未披露，不能判scaling。
synthesis.why_now: 模型访问和基础Agent框架快速商品化，交付瓶颈转向把一次客户学习沉淀为可治理、可部署、可升级且不携带错误权限和脆弱依赖的生产资产。多个平台已建立模板库、Marketplace、Skills和Solution Accelerators，竞争从会不会做项目进入谁能经营资产生命周期。
winner_conditions: 资产拥有稳定身份、版本、依赖、适用边界、测试集、权限和退役责任
业务语义、数据契约和验收指标与代码/模板共同打包
跨客户复用时定制工时下降且生产质量、合规和可观测性不退化
Marketplace分发与运行时、计量、升级、回滚和收益归因相连
伙伴贡献的行业蓝图能回流产品，同时客户保留数据、权限与最终验收权

evidence.source_quote: AWS Marketplace now offers Agent-to-Agent (A2A) server support and streamlined deployment for third-party AI agents and tools built for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime. The new capabilities accelerate deployment by pre-populating required environment variables in the AgentCore console and AWS CLI instructions in AWS Marketplace. Customers can now also procure and deploy A2A servers on AgentCore Runtime through AWS Marketplace, making it easier for them to leverage AI agents from AWS Partners. The improvements reduce deployment complexity by leveraging vendor-defined launch configurations while adding protocol flexibility to meet diverse customer needs. AWS Partners can now offer A2A servers in addition to MCP servers and AI agents using AgentCore Runtime containers in the AWS Marketplace Management Portal. To accelerate customer onboarding, AWS Partners can define required environment variables for AgentCore Runtime supported products so that customers can quickly get started. AWS Partners can also enable free pricing for API-based SaaS products. These capabilities provide AWS Partners with the flexibility to bring new products to market and implement pricing strategies that align with their business models and customers’ needs. Customers can learn more in the buyer guide and start exploring AI agent solutions in AWS Marketplace on the solutions page . For AWS Partners interes

evidence.source_quote: Agent templates and managed agents are provided as examples to help makers get started with building an agent for their business. evidence.source_quote: Databricks Marketplace gives data providers a secure platform for sharing data products that data scientists and analysts can use to help their organizations succeed. Databricks Marketplace uses OpenSharing to provide security and control over your shared data. You can share public data, free sample data, and commercialized data offerings. You can share data products in public listings or as part of private exchanges that you create, making listings discoverable only by member consumers. In addition to datasets, you can also share Databricks notebooks, machine learning models, and MCP servers to demonstrate use cases and provide tools that help customers succeed with agents.
